config.source: BLS producer price indexes by commodity via FRED, monthly, every title read off FRED rather than inferred from the id. WPU0638 pharmaceutical preparations (aggregate) and its eight therapeutic classes WPU063801–WPU063808, all index Jun 2001=100 and running Jun 2001→Jun 2026; WPU06380802 broad and medium spectrum antibiotics, index Dec 2009=100, Dec 2009→Jun 2026; PCU325411325411 medicinal and botanical manufacturing (the active-ingredient input), index Jun 1982=100; CPIAUCSL to deflate
config.note: WPU063801–08 is the COMPLETE set — 063809, 063810 and 063811 were probed and do not exist, so no class is silently dropped. WPU06380802 is a sub-line of 063808 and starts eight years later, so it is never compared to the others over their full span. These are commodity indexes covering human and veterinary products together; BLS publishes no veterinary-only line. Index numbers, not quantities — only changes between dates are meaningful, and the antibiotic line sits on a different base month from the rest.
